title: Confluence of PCUIC reduction, transported to the well-scoped presentation
intent: The main theorem `red_confluence` (confluence of the raw reduction `red` on PCUIC terms) is proved with no reduction reasoning in its own proof: the glue transports its two `red` hypotheses into the well-scoped presentation `ws_red`, applies the already-proven confluence of `ws_red`, and transports the two `ws_red` conclusions back to `red`.
also_known_as: prove in the well-scoped presentation, specialise to the raw relation

parent.name: red_confluence
parent.statement:
Lemma red_confluence {Γ : closed_context} {t : open_term Γ} {u v} :
    red Σ Γ t u -> red Σ Γ t v ->
    ∑ v', red Σ Γ u v' * red Σ Γ v v'.

children.name: red_ws_red_left
children.statement:
Lemma red_ws_red_left {Γ : closed_context} {x : ws_term (shiftnP #|Γ| xpred0)} {y} :
    red Σ Γ x y -> ∑ prf, ws_red Σ xpred0 Γ x (exist y prf).
children.closed_by: eapply red_ws_red (after `have ony : on_free_vars (shiftnP #|Γ| xpred0) y by eauto with fvs`)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: red Σ Γ x y gives ws_red Σ xpred0 Γ x (exist y prf), returning a proof that the reduct y is well-scoped

children.name: ws_red_confluence
children.statement:
Lemma ws_red_confluence {Γ t u v} :
    ws_red Σ xpred0 Γ t u -> ws_red Σ xpred0 Γ t v ->
    ∑ v', ws_red Σ xpred0 Γ u v' * ws_red Σ xpred0 Γ v v'.
children.closed_by: red1_confluent (one-step confluence of ws_red1), closed by `exists nf; intuition auto`
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: ws_red Σ xpred0 Γ is confluent

children.name: ws_red_red
children.statement:
Lemma ws_red_red Γ t u :
    ws_red Σ xpred0 Γ t u ->
    red Σ Γ t u.
children.closed_by: dependent induction `depind H` on the clos_refl_trans proof, closing its three constructors (uses its own IH `IHclos_refl_trans1`; `Proof using Type`, no wfΣ)
children.note: Analyst's paraphrase, replaced by the declaration's text: ws_red Σ xpred0 Γ t u implies red Σ Γ t u

applicability.goal_shape: Confluence (or any closure property) of a raw relation `red` on open terms, when `red` is the same reduction as a well-scoped presentation `ws_red` restricted to terms that carry a proof of an invariant (here `on_free_vars`), and the two presentations are linked by transport lemmas `red ⇒ ws_red` and `ws_red ⇒ red`.
applicability.use_when: the invariant (well-scopedness) is preserved by the relation, so the transport lemmas are easy and the heavy confluence work can be done once in the well-scoped presentation where a diamond lemma (`red1_confluent`, ultimately `pred1_diamond`) is available.
applicability.avoid_when: the invariant does not hold on the raw relation's range or is not preserved by reduction, so `red_ws_red_left` cannot be stated; or when the transport lemmas are themselves as hard as the target, in which case there is no saving from the round-trip.

consequences: The move relies on the invariant being preserved by reduction: `red_ws_red_left` must recover `on_free_vars … y` for the reduct `y`, which holds only because reduction preserves free variables (discharged by `eauto with fvs`). The parent is therefore restricted to a well-scoped starting term (`t : open_term Γ`); a raw term outside that presentation cannot be transported. The glue is only as good as the well-scoped confluence `ws_red_confluence`, which itself rests on the deep parallel-reduction diamond `pred1_diamond` (imported from `PCUICParallelReductionConfluence`); any strengthening of the reduction relation has to be re-proven there, not in this glue.
